sentences.text: Starboard-side lateral marks are red with red lights, and port-side marks are green with green lights.
Preferred channel marks have red and green bands and a composite group-flashing light in the color of the top band.
Safe water marks have red and white vertical stripes and a white Morse A light.
Isolated danger marks are black with red bands and a white light flashing in groups of two.
Special marks are yellow, with yellow lights.
If you know this table, you can identify nearly any mark the exam describes.
